input.overview: Pool Champion uses the upper B-A-L-L targets and top hole for its Red Special route. Complete B-A-L-L, then shoot the top hole to open the upper gate and score the 8 Ball. Each lit 8 BALL lane entry spots a B-A-L-L letter; completing the word lights Red Special. The three center targets light SHOOT NOW, and completing that sequence advances Orange Special. The side Ball Return lane advances its lamps until a lit pass returns the ball, while upper buttons and targets advance the bonus multiplier.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the upper B-A-L-L targets, then shoot the top hole to open the gate and score the 8 Ball. Use the lit 8 BALL lane to spot B-A-L-L letters toward Red Special. Complete the three center targets for SHOOT NOW and Orange Special. Build the side Ball Return lane for a saved ball.
input.summary: Finish B-A-L-L before taking the top hole, then use the lit 8 BALL lane to move toward Red Special. Take SHOOT NOW from the center targets when ready, or build Ball Return when the side lane is the safer shot.

steps.text: Complete the upper B-A-L-L targets, then shoot the top hole to open the upper gate and score the 8 Ball.
Use the lit 8 BALL lane to spot a B-A-L-L letter; complete the word to light Red Special.
Knock down the three center targets to light SHOOT NOW, then complete the lit sequence to advance Orange Special.
Use the upper buttons and fixed targets to advance the bonus multiplier.

alternatives.title: Build Ball Return
alternatives.when: Use this when the side return lane is safer than the upper target routes.

steps.text: Repeat the Ball Return lane to advance its three lamps.
Enter the lane while Ball Return is lit to send the ball back to the shooter lane.
Use the target bank and lit 8 BALL lane to fill missing letters.
Convert the completed word at Red Special before rebuilding the upper route.

machineSetup: Check the Red and Orange Special difficulty settings, right-kickback lane requirement, ball count, and configured awards.
Test B-A-L-L targets, top hole and gate, 8 BALL lane, three center targets, SHOOT NOW lamps, Ball Return lane, upper buttons, and multiplier lamps.

cautions.issue: Special and Ball Return thresholds are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: Use the lane and sequence lamps instead of assuming a fixed number of passes.
